concerns.text: FR-016 does not reference any user story. It only cites other FRs (FR-014, FR-010) which themselves are anchored, but FR-016 itself lacks an explicit story anchor, making it an orphaned functional requirement.
FR-019 references FR-001 but does not name a user story. Without an explicit story anchor, this functional requirement is orphaned.

FR-001 specifies retrieval of the IL‑Benchmark dataset from a Zenodo DOI `` (empty string). Because the DOI is missing, the requirement cannot be satisfied, violating Constitution Principle VI which mandates benchmarking against a verified high‑level reference dataset.

FR-008 specifies retrieval of experimental bulk‑property data via the endpoint ` No address associated with hostname)"))]` (malformed/empty). The missing/invalid endpoint makes the requirement impossible to fulfill, again breaching Constitution Principle VI.

FR-001 cites an empty Zenodo DOI (``) as the source of the IL‑Benchmark dataset. Without a concrete, reachable identifier the system cannot retrieve the required CCSD(T)/CBS reference energies and XYZ coordinates, making the functional requirement untestable and violating the ‘acceptance inputs are reachable’ rule.

FR-008 specifies a malformed NIST API endpoint (` No address associated with hostname)"))]`) that does not resolve to any service. Consequently the bulk‑property retrieval step cannot be exercised, rendering the requirement unverifiable.

FR-006–FR-018 introduce a full scaling‑factor fitting and residual‑diagnostics pipeline. The original idea only asks whether DFT‑D3 predicts ion‑pair interaction energies accurately; a post‑hoc scaling correction is not required to answer that research question, so this adds work beyond the stated scope.

FR-008–FR-011 (and US‑3) add an exploratory correlation between D3 terms (raw or scaled) and bulk properties (density, viscosity). The idea does not request any bulk‑property analysis, thus the spec redefines the research question to include a separate hypothesis, constituting scope drift/over‑reach.

FR-001 cites a Zenodo DOI placeholder (``) for the IL‑Benchmark dataset. Without a concrete, accessible source of CCSD(T)/CBS reference interaction energies and XYZ coordinates, the primary validation target is undefined, making the benchmark and all downstream error analyses impossible. This violates the requirement that the benchmark be directly retrieved (Constitution Principle VI) and renders the validation circular/absent.

FR-008 specifies a NIST API endpoint placeholder (" No address associated with hostname)")] for experimental bulk‑property data. The absence of a real endpoint means the correlation analysis (US‑3) has no independent ground‑truth bulk properties, undermining the exploratory validation of D3 relevance to density/viscosity. The study cannot fulfill its claimed correlation objectives without real data.
